scope: Single-task native prompt refactor; diagnostic subsets, not full benchmarks. ChromaBench interpreted as repository KramaBench.
attempt_policy: One attempt per task/configuration, no recovery task reruns or best-of selection. In-loop operator repairs retained.
fairness: Same 300-token shared analysis principles, model, requested inputs, 25 steps, 8192 response-token ceiling, 900 seconds, 5000 full/print characters. Different tool interfaces, execution/context units and isolation; native optional data/flow each gets independent 2000-char budgets.

tests.unit_validation_note: Full 1,404-test suite passed on the refactor; 171 focused tests passed after behavior-preserving cleanup.

cost_scope: Agent API token estimate only; excludes grading and compute. Frozen fallback pricing, cached input discounted, reasoning included in output.
limitations: No fresh old-prompt control, so accuracy retention and dollar savings caused by refactor alone are not established.
Single attempt per small preselected subset, no confidence intervals.
DA-Code statistical reference population/method restrictions are omitted from supplied question; absolute0.01 tolerance accepts materially different p-values.
DA-Code regression target is reconstructed from supplied engineered fields; this weakly tests predictive modeling.

reports.raw_artifacts: Raw traces, wire payloads and runtime manifests are retained locally and intentionally not versioned.

implementation_note: Code cleanup preserves all 32 rendered prompt/tool combinations from the model-run implementation. No model calls were made during cleanup.
